scope: Read-only local gateway/registry diagnostics and authenticated Vision One console inspection. No policy, credential, deployment or application code changes.

activity_delivery_snapshot.note: Counters belong to the current process; not a lifetime total. Per-upstream list work can exceed client list requests.

fresh_cloud_catalog_event.note: The displayed activity record is not proof of the contents or absence of a separate inventory-reporting channel.

ruled_out: Traffic bypasses Trend for the verified probe
Local absence of the exact credential filename
An available newer public chart identified by Helm resolution
conclusions.confirmed_failure: Console active discovery cannot resolve its credential file, so that import workflow never receives candidate tools.
conclusions.likely_inventory_failure_area: Missing/incompatible MCP inventory reporting, cloud inventory ingestion, or preview-feature behavior; successful activity events alone do not populate inventory.
conclusions.likely_active_discovery_failure_area: Discovery executor/secret context differs from the verified local gateway, or uses another stale/different context; execution location was not established.
